symptoms: Yellow-orange powdery spots on leaves and stems.
causes: Caused by Puccinia fungus, spreads in humid conditions.
control: Use resistant varieties, apply Mancozeb or Propiconazole fungicides.

symptoms: Small circular brown spots with gray center on leaves.
causes: Poor soil nutrients and fungal infection by Bipolaris oryzae.
control: Apply balanced fertilizer, use seed treatment, and spray Carbendazim.

symptoms: Bolls bored with larvae inside; yield loss observed.
causes: Larvae of Helicoverpa armigera feed on developing bolls.
control: Use pheromone traps, apply neem-based pesticide or Chlorpyrifos.

symptoms: Upward curling leaves, stunted plants, reduced fruiting.
causes: Spread by whiteflies under warm conditions.
control: Control whiteflies using Imidacloprid and remove infected plants.
